settings.breed_blurb: Long, low and endlessly entertaining — Dachshunds have a unique body shape that requires special sizing for the perfect fit.
settings.tip_lehenga: Look for lehengas with a longer back length — Dachshunds have a uniquely long torso so back coverage matters.
settings.tip_sherwani: A long-body sherwani style works best. Measure back length carefully — most Dachshunds need 38–44 cm back length.
settings.tip_tshirt: Long-body tees or stretchable tees work best for Dachshunds. Prioritise back length over chest size when selecting.
settings.tip_colours: Warm reds, golden yellows and rich browns complement the Dachshund's tan and chocolate coat tones beautifully.
